notes: Jinshu 001 explicitly identifies 宣皇帝 as Sima Yi, courtesy Zhongda; its continuous biography and retrospective textual note all identify the same man. Jinshu 023 celebrates the same Meng Da, Zhuge Liang and Gongsun/Liaodong campaigns; Jinshu 031 identifies the same Cao-Wei general and father of Jingdi/Wendi. Preserve the three existing root members.
The root is Jin’s Sima Yi, anchored by the existing 司馬宣王/Meng Da members and Jin ancestral context.

jiutangshu:029:s0145,s0159–s0167 discusses the Tang ancestral temple’s seven generations and removal of 宣皇帝’s tablet. This is the Tang ancestor conventionally named Li Xi, not the Wei general posthumously honored by Jin. The reused title does not establish identity.
